blogs.title: Early postoperative thrombocytopenia after CPB: when pre-op heparin flips the script
blogs.description: Explores rapid-onset HIT/aHIT after cardiac surgery, triggered by small preoperative UFH exposures (eg, diagnostic cath). Reviews how the usual POD5–10 window can be misleading, how to interpret the 4Ts in CPB patients, and practical steps to avoid anchoring on benign post-CPB thrombocytopenia when the trajectory and timing suggest immune thrombocytopenia with thrombotic risk.

blogs.title: When the SRA says “indeterminate”: decoding aHIT with heparin-independent activation
blogs.description: Dissects atypical platelet activation profiles in aHIT: serotonin release at 0 U/mL heparin, paradoxical strength at low-dose heparin, and partial resistance to FcγRIIa (IV.3) blockade. Provides a lab-facing checklist—ask for no-heparin conditions, PF4-enhanced assays, alternative functional tests (eg, P-selectin expression), and emphasizes clinician–lab dialogue to prevent missed aHIT diagnoses.

blogs.title: Managing fulminant aHIT after cardiac surgery: from argatroban to fondaparinux (and why AT matters)
blogs.description: Walks through anticoagulant strategy in severe aHIT with consumptive coagulopathy and stroke risk: initial DTI selection (argatroban vs bivalirudin), indications to pivot to fondaparinux, and the rationale for antithrombin supplementation in AT-dependent Xa inhibition. Highlights using fibrinogen, D-dimer, and smear schistocytes to track control of hypercoagulability when conventional PTT/anti-Xa targets are inadequate.

blogs.title: IVIG for aHIT: mechanism, dosing, and why some patients barely budge
blogs.description: Reviews IVIG’s role in aHIT (Fc receptor blockade, anti-idiotype effects), dosing strategies (1–2 g/kg over 1–2 days and when to add a third dose), expected platelet kinetics, and safety after major surgery or stroke. Uses the case to discuss predictors of poor response, the need for concomitant potent anticoagulation, and escalation options in refractory disease.

blogs.title: No more heparins: postoperative prophylaxis pivots when HIT is on the table
blogs.description: Examines postoperative anticoagulation choices after CPB when HIT/aHIT is suspected or confirmed. Contrasts UFH vs LMWH risks after cardiac surgery, argues for early cessation of all heparins, and outlines practical use of fondaparinux for prophylaxis or treatment, dosing nuances in renal function, and transitioning back to long-term anticoagulation once platelet counts recover.

blogs.title: Antibody phenotype drift in aHIT: implications for future heparin exposure and follow-up
blogs.description: Discusses longitudinal changes from heparin-independent to heparin-dependent HIT antibody profiles, how this informs the duration of non-heparin anticoagulation, and counseling about future procedures. Covers documentation (medical alerts), retesting strategies, and whether/when heparin can ever be safely reintroduced versus defaulting to heparin alternatives.
